title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.17267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. translated_title: LiveGeo：在持续演化世界中评测地理智能体的基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GeoWorld，一个面向LLM智能体的可控且持续演化的地理环境平台，以及LiveGeo，一个基于GeoWorld来评估智能体在真实地理环境中可靠决策能力的基准测试。与现有主要在固定地理状态下进行推理和规划的评估方法不同，GeoWorld植根于真实世界的地理结构，允许外部世界状态按照自身的时间进程不断演化，同时保留可验证的状态历史。LiveGeo将地理任务置于这一不断演化的环境之中，要求智能体主动获取与任务相关的信息，验证支持先前决策的证据是否仍然有效，并在必要时修订其计划。我们的结果显示，即使是最前沿的LLM在静态任务中也表现挣扎，没有任何模型能在所有任务中持续表现优异，而且强大的静态性能并不能保证动态可靠性。进一步的分析识别……
tldr: 该论文提出了GeoWorld平台与LiveGeo基准，通过持续演化的真实地理环境评测LLM智能体的可靠决策能力，发现即使是前沿模型在静态任务中也表现不佳，且良好的静态性能并不能保证动态可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GeoWorld and LiveGeo, a continuously evolving geographic environment platform and benchmark for evaluating reliable LLM agent decision-making, revealing that even frontier models struggle with static tasks and strong static performance does not guarantee dynamic reliability.
